426:t_002:0.en:
$$葵$$
「For the $$スフィア・リアクター$$s to all volunteer to sortie together, something serious must be going on.」

426:t_002:1.en:
$$スザク$$
「$n... Did you sense $$サイデリアル$$ Reactors approaching?」

426:t_002:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「To be honest, I can't really tell myself.」

426:t_002:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I just have a bad feeling...」

426:t_002:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「At times like this, you should check with your own eyes, so we sortied. That's all there is to it.」

426:t_002:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Let's give it everything, $n. Your ex-girlfriend's at that base, right?」

426:t_002:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I wouldn't do anything that tactless. Not that I had the time, with my hands full holding back $$ロックオン$$, $$青山$$, $$デュオ$$ and $$クルツ$$.」

426:t_002:10.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「I-I just... uh... it's force of habit. I got worried about $n, is all...」

426:t_002:11.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Yeah, yeah! It's just the curse of being a short-straw guy!」

426:t_002:13.en:
$$デュオ$$
「You spent all that time denying you ever joined up, and now you act like one of the gang only when it's convenient?」

426:t_002:15.en:
$$フェルト$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ is incoming!」

426:t_002:16.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, prepare to intercept! We can't hand that base over, if only to find out what $$サイデリアル$$'s strategic objectives are!」

426:t_003:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「And on top of that, $$アマルガム$$ is here too!」

426:t_003:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「So they made a business trip all the way to this Earth on $$サイデリアル$$'s orders, huh.」

426:t_003:4.en:
$$宗介$$
(If I keep fighting them, I may be able to get information on $$アマルガム$$... on $$千鳥$$...)

426:t_003:5.en:
$$尸刻$$
「It has been a while, everyone at $c.」

426:t_003:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Talking all polite won't get you anywhere, sis. That gloomy guy is behind you, isn't he?」

426:t_003:8.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「If they're sending out mass-produced squad leader units, the enemy has finally gotten serious!」

426:t_003:9.en:
$$シモン$$
「So somebody finally lit a fire under their butts!」

426:t_003:10.en:
$$尸刻$$
「I will not deny it. $$サイデリアル$$ has judged you to be people who possess that much power.」

426:t_003:11.en:
$$尸刻$$
「We of $$鬼宿$$ have also been ordered to use $$尸冥爪$$. Please learn what that means firsthand.」

426:t_003:12.en:
$$アムロ$$
「A roundabout way of putting it, but what you mean is that you intend to crush us here.」

426:t_003:13.en:
$$キラ$$
「So the facility in this base really does hold important meaning for you.」

426:t_003:15.en:
$$桂$$
「Clamming up when it gets inconvenient. That's the classic girl move.」

426:t_003:16.en:
$$万丈$$
「Sorry, but we don't bow to threats. If you've brought in a decisive weapon, we'll simply defeat it.」

426:t_003:17.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, stay alert! $$尸空#pilot$$ of the $$沈黙の巨蟹$$ should be somewhere behind them!」

426:t_003:18.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Let's go, $n! When you're lost, you move forward...! That's the iron rule!」

426:t_003:20.en:
$n
($$マキ#pilot$$, $$シンヤ#pilot$$, $$ミサコ#pilot$$... I'll protect them...!)

426:t_003:21.en:
$$レナード$$
「It looks like it's beginning.」

426:t_003:22.en:
$$サビーナ$$
「We came here to test that system, and the base has already fallen...」

426:t_003:23.en:
$$レナード$$
「No matter. Just coming near it gave me inspiration... That's enough.」

426:t_003:25.en:
$$レナード$$
「We've accomplished our immediate goal. Let's watch $c in action, then head home.」

426:t_003:26.en:
$$レナード$$
「We will end up clashing with them sooner or later... That is not a premonition, but a certainty.」

426:t_005:1.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「They seem to be having some trouble.」

426:t_005:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I'll take it from here. Fall back.」

426:t_006:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What kind of answer is that! If you don't feel like fighting, go home!」

426:t_006:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So you don't intend to go home.」

426:t_007:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Your woman gets taken down and you don't even bat an eye!」

426:t_007:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I may have said this before, but we are not in that kind of relationship.」

426:t_007:9.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What kind of answer is that! If you don't feel like fighting, go home!」

426:t_007:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So you don't intend to go home.」

426:t_009:0.en:
$$シン$$
「Even after dealing that much damage, we can't break down that guy's void!?」

426:t_011:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「A bluff? That's not like you, $$尸空#pilot$$.」

kept_omissions: 426:t_005:1: who is 'having trouble' is unstated; kept as 'They'
426:t_003:20: the object of 守ってみせる is unstated; taken as the three people just named, in third person
426:t_002:7: 見たんですか - what was seen is unstated; kept as 'Did you see?'
uncertain: 426:t_005:0: 尸空だけなのですか？ - unclear whether Shikoku asks Shikuu directly or speaks of him; rendered 'Is it only Shikuu?' with his reply 'They seem to be having some trouble'
426:t_002:7-8: taken as $n asking if Crowe watched the reunion with the ex (Maki); Lockon, Aoyama, Duo, Kurz then apparently tried to peek
426:t_007:2: reused Tengoku 295:t_029:2 but changed 'that is not our relationship' to 'we are not in that kind of relationship' (closer to そういった関係ではない); 295:t_029:2 may want the same fix
426:t_007:0-6: mid-battle exchange after Shikoku is downed; reused Tengoku English from 295:t_029 as instructed
426:t_003:8: 隊長機の量産型 = 'mass-produced squad leader units'
426:t_003:16: 決戦兵器 = 'decisive weapon' (no settled rendering found)
426:t_002:11: 貧乏くじ体質の性 = 'the curse of being a short-straw guy'
